name: Specialization trees grant their free nodes with automatic progression off (#4436)
contract: A specialization tree hangs from free (AECost 0, TECost 0) nodes the class grants: Knight of Xoroth War's identity Crusher 4016 (spell 92100), Warbringer 12166 (570727, requires 4016), and the level-gated passives Ripper 11261 (706331, level 20), Carver 30705 (707390, level 30), Render 9262 (704951, level 40) and Knight of the Apocalypse 4217 (520296, level 50); Defiance's identity 4018 (92104) and Shieldgore (301302). The Books of Ascension never sell a tree's free nodes, so they must still be granted when CoA.AutoProgression is 0 (the shipped default, read from the realm's module config). Without them the client draws Warbringer 0/1 and every node below it locked, since each requires Crusher, while it draws the level-gated passives as learned from the level alone. Switching specialization removes the old tree's spells and must grant the new tree's free nodes; levelling up must grant the passives the new level reaches.
